botserv_nick.description: The name/nick of the BotServ client/service.

botserv_user.description: The username (ident) of the BotServ client.

botserv_host.description: The hostname of the BotServ client.

botserv_gecos.description: The realname/gecos of the BotServ client.

botserv_defaults.description: Default bot options for newly registered channels, separated by spaces.

botserv_minusers.description: Minimum number of users in a channel before the bot joins.

botserv_botmodes.description: Modes to set on service bots when they join channels.

botserv_badwordsmax.description: Maximum number of entries a single bad words list can have.

botserv_kick_keepdata.description: Time that data for a user is valid in BotServ (e.g., 10m, 1h).
